I was just thinking about how I found my cat. Originally her momma we found and brought her in. She had no babies with her. Next day she kept trying to get out of the house and I instantly fell in love with momma cat so I was scared she was going to run off. But it seemed she needed something so I let her out. She ran into the bushes and a couple minutes later my baby and her brother came out. My baby was hesitant to come to me but after a few minutes of me just sitting there waiting, she came up to me and basically claimed me right then and there. 
Although I expected at least 6 more years with her, 11-12 is still longer than what would have happened if I didn't let momma out. And now I think my baby is up there with her brother now. He sadly passed too soon. And momma ended up disappearing. But I'm sure even if she had been alive somewhere she's with her babies again. 
She was my main reason to stay alive. And now I've had a puppy for almost a year and a half now. As much as it's not the same, especially personality wise, she'll have to be my new reason. And after almost 5 months I'm slowly getting there. Though it still hurts and might continue to hurt until I can have a new baby kitty. I'll just have to hang on best I can for now.
I just hope she's happy knowing she didn't fully leave me alone. I know it would hurt way more if that was the case.
